Counting the grapes on the plate gives about 20 (roughly 18 red and 2 green). The plate is square, about 20 cm across, so these look like small grapes, perhaps 3 cm long.

At about 3 g to 4 g each, 20 grapes come to roughly 70 g to 80 g. Some of the grapes look larger, so I'll estimate about 90 g in total.

Grapes have about 0.69 kcal/g, so 90 g is about 62 kcal.
